message: Hi, my son is 7 and wants to try jiu jitsu. What classes do you have for his age?

Hey! That's awesome your son wants to try Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu! We have a Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu program that's perfect for 7-year-olds. The classes are grouped by age with instruction designed just for kids in a safe, fun environment. Would you like to book a free trial class for him?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class for Max! What’s the next available slot?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's Max's date of birth? This helps us make sure he's in the right age group.
Max's date of birth is February 10, 2019.

Perfect! Max is 7, so he'll be in our Kids 6-7 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. Here are the next available times for his free trial:

Monday 7/6 at 5:00 PM (today)
Wednesday 7/8 at 5:00 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with today, Monday 7/6 at 5:00 PM.
Perfect! Max is all set for his free trial today, Monday 7/6 at 5:00 PM. Just need your email and phone number to complete the booking. What's the best email to send the details to?
